source_frontmatter.name: photo-rename
source_frontmatter.description: Rename photos using image analysis, GPS metadata, and web research to generate descriptive real-world filenames such as "grand_canyon_phantom_ranch.jpg" or "eiffel_tower_paris.jpg". Trigger immediately when the user's message starts with "rp", or when they upload photos and ask to rename, identify, or label them by location or content. Supports batch processing.
